headline: GRAINGER DECLARES QUARTERLY DIVIDEND
summary: W.W. Grainger, Inc. (NYSE: GWW) announced today that its board of directors approved a quarterly cash dividend of $2.49 per share. The dividend is payable on September 1, 2026, to shareholders of record on August 10, 2026.
